recap.description: Two or three short sentences for the user: what is now true or changed, and where it stands, including what is not done or not verified. No recommendation here.

ask.description: The one decision that waits on the user, as one short sentence. Leave it out when nothing waits on them.

actions.description: With ask: one or two answers the user can pick with a click, 1 to 3 words each, written as the user's reply. Your recommendation first.
